latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker Free Canva — AI-powered video creation from your images and clips, no Canva Pro needed.

- Instantly create polished promotional videos by uploading images or clips (PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV up to 500MB).
- Describe your desired video (text overlays, music, aspect ratio)—AI handles editing, rendering, and exports a 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Easy, free token setup—no login required; every session includes 100 credits, valid for 7 days.
- Supports preview, iterative editing, balance checks, and batch processing directly through chat commands.
- All major video, audio, and image formats supported; built-in error handling and session management.
- Designed for small business owners and creators seeking a hassle-free alternative to Canva Pro for video projects.
